'''Lily''' (Japanese: '''リリ''' ''Lily'') is [[Hiori]]'s long lost twin sister in [[Phantom Thief Pokémon 7]].

==Character==
Lily has the power to read a Pokémon's [[aura]]. Because of this power, she was kidnapped by [[Team Galactic]] when she was only five years old while playing a game of {{wp|hide-and-seek}} with Hiori and his {{p|Riolu}}. Lily was shown to be at a high rank in Team Galactic, working along with her section leader's second-in-command and receiving missions from her in person.

==History==
[[File:Lily Pokémon 7 Galactic.png|thumb|150px|left|Lily as a member of Team Galactic]]
In her first appearance, she was being chased by [[Hiori|Pokémon 7]] and [[Rocco]] for stealing a woman's {{p|Chingling}}. However, her brother's {{p|Lucario}} was unable to read her aura due to a special cloak made by Team Galactic. Later, it was revealed in a battle with Pokémon 7 that she had lost all memories of before she was kidnapped and is currently being brainwashed by her {{p|Mismagius}}. 

After winning back her memories, she revealed that her section leader, [[Io]], captured {{p|Darkrai}} and was planning on using its powers to take over the world. She, along with Hiori and Rocco, found Darkrai in captivity under protection of Io and her second-in-command. They defeated them both, but not until after Io awoke Darkrai, causing it to go on a rampage. They eventually calmed down Darkrai enough to set it free. but was caught in a cave-in caused by the battle. She was later revealed to be alive and well a month later roaming the world with Rocco and Pokémon 7 after the former saved them all with his {{p|Gardevoir}}.
